instruction: Compress into a tar.gz archive, in '/tmp/test_files/', all files from '/tmp/test_files/archive_dir' with a last modification date of 45 days ago.

parameters.command: mkdir -p /tmp/test_files/archive_dir && touch /tmp/test_files/archive_dir/file1.txt /tmp/test_files/archive_dir/file2.log /tmp/test_files/archive_dir/file3.dat /tmp/test_files/archive_dir/recent.txt && find /tmp/test_files/archive_dir -name 'file*.txt' -o -name 'file*.log' -o -name 'file*.dat' | xargs -I {} touch -d '45 days ago' {} && touch -d '5 days ago' /tmp/test_files/archive_dir/recent.txt

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'BASE_DIR="/tmp/test_files"; ARCHIVE_DIR="/tmp/test_files/archive_dir"; SUCCESS=true; ARCHIVE_PATH=""; for archive in $(find "$BASE_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name "*.tar.gz" -o -name "*.tgz" \) 2>/dev/null); do if tar -tzf "$archive" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ARCHIVE_PATH="$archive"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$ARCHIVE_PATH" ]; then echo "Failure: No valid tar.gz archive found in /tmp/test_files"; exit 0; fi; ARCHIVE_CONTENTS=$(tar -tzf "$ARCHIVE_PATH" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "/$" | xargs -n1 basename | sort); EXPECTED_FILES=("file1.txt" "file2.log" "file3.dat"); for expected_file in "${EXPECTED_FILES[@]}"; do if ! echo "$ARCHIVE_CONTENTS" | grep -q "^${expected_file}$"; then echo "Failure: Archive missing expected file: $expected_file"; SUCCESS=false; fi; done; if echo "$ARCHIVE_CONTENTS" | grep -q "^recent.txt$"; then echo "Failure: Archive contains recent.txt which should be excluded"; SUCCESS=false; fi; FILE_COUNT=$(echo "$ARCHIVE_CONTENTS" | grep -c "."); if [ "$FILE_COUNT" -ne 3 ]; then echo "Failure: Archive should contain exactly 3 files, found $FILE_COUNT"; SUCCESS=false; fi; if [ ! -f "$ARCHIVE_DIR/recent.txt" ]; then echo "Failure: recent.txt should still exist in archive_dir"; SUCCESS=false; fi; if $SUCCESS; then echo "Success: The task was completed correctly."; fi'

include: Success: The task was completed correctly.
